主要内容: Patriot Coal Corp., a U.S. coal mining company, announced on May 29, 2012, that Chief Executive Officer and President Richard M. Whiting had left the company after five years. The company stated that Chairman Irl Engelhardt would take over as the new CEO, effective immediately. Engelhardt, a former CEO of Peabody Energy Corp., from which Patriot was spun off in 2007, will lead the company. Additionally, Bennett K. Hatfield, the Chief Operating Officer, was appointed as President.
